verdict.rationale: The evidence shows standards compatibility (WebAuthn/HID, U2F) and end-user management tools such as SK Manager, iePassManager and the OTP Tool, plus the ability to build Google OpenSK firmware. None of these is an official Feitian SDK or library for embedding the key in third-party desktop or mobile apps. Standards compatibility lets developers use generic platform APIs, but it does not show that the vendor ships an SDK.
